title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Evaluating Responses - Evaluation Committees
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: During an RFP evaluation, an evaluation committee member realizes their spouse is an executive at one of the firms that submitted a proposal. What is the immediate required action?
options: The member must simply score that particular vendor objectively
The member must disclose the conflict of interest immediately and recuse themselves from the evaluation committee entirely
The member may evaluate the proposals but must skip scoring that specific vendor
The vendor's proposal must be automatically disqualified
questions.explain: Any actual or perceived conflict of interest must be disclosed immediately, and the compromised evaluator must be removed from the committee to maintain the integrity of the procurement process.
questions.subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: When conducting technical evaluation committee meetings, standard best practice to arrive at a fair final score for each proposal is to:
options: Have the procurement officer dictate the scores to ensure mathematical accuracy
Allow the requesting department director to override the committee's scores
Have evaluators score independently first, then meet to discuss variances and achieve a consensus score or allow score revisions based on group fact-finding
Force evaluators to debate until all individual scores are identical
questions.explain: Best practice involves independent review followed by a group consensus meeting where evaluators can discuss their findings, ensure nothing was missed, and optionally adjust their scores based on clarified facts before final tallying.
questions.subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: What is the primary role of the Procurement Officer during an RFP technical evaluation committee meeting?
options: To serve as the tie-breaking vote on technical quality
To aggressively argue for the vendor with the lowest price
To act as a neutral facilitator, ensuring the committee adheres to the RFP evaluation criteria, follows procurement law, and documents their decisions properly
To dictate the final scores to the end-users
questions.explain: The Procurement Officer acts as a procedural guide and compliance officer. They ensure fairness, guard against bias, and ensure evaluations strictly follow the published rubric. They typically do not score the technical aspects themselves.
